as_told.title: Townsend Brown's Winterhaven proposal cites Heaviside gravity

plain: A 1953 proposal by the scientist Thomas Townsend Brown, written in Winter Haven, Florida, is said to lay out almost exactly what insiders now describe as America's secret UFO program. Michels makes this claim himself in his documentary about Brown, comparing the old plan to later insider accounts. A host named Jack brings up a different line from it. He says the proposal argues that the physicist Oliver Heaviside had a very adequate theory of gravity back in the 1890s, and that we would be right to listen to him. If Michels is right, the plan for such a program was on paper as early as 1953.
